title: Knitwear manufacturer in Southern Europe for 300-piece runs
body: We are adding four knitwear styles to the permanent collection and need a factory that treats a 300-piece order as a real order. Fabric comes from our existing mills; we need cut-make-trim plus finishing, with development samples inside two weeks.

title: Recycled concrete supplier for a Fribourg school project
body: Public tender for a 4,800 m² primary school. We need structural precast with declared recycled aggregate content above 55%, delivered within 200 km of Fribourg, and an EPD we can put straight into the material passport.

title: GOTS-certified jersey mill for a repeat programme
body: Two of our brand customers want the same jersey base four times a year. We are looking for a knitting mill that can hold yarn lots and guarantee shade continuity across drops, rather than requoting every season.

title: Low-carbon insulation for 4,200 m² of timber frame
body: Timber frame residential project in Vaud. We need bio-based batts with a published EPD, thermal conductivity at or below 0.040 W/mK, and a documented end-of-life route. Mineral wool will not clear our material passport requirements.
skills: Compostable or recyclable end of life

title: Garment factories with cutting-room waste to divert
body: We buy post-industrial cutting waste by composition and colour. If your factory currently pays for disposal, we will collect from 500 kg and pay per tonne on clean single-composition lots. Looking for four to six regular partners in Iberia.

title: Certification partner for demountable glazing EPD
body: Our demountable spacer system has no existing category rule that covers reglazing as a service life extension. We are looking for a certification body or LCA consultancy willing to develop the methodology with us and stand behind the result. Open to anyone who has done this before.

title: Single-origin cotton yarn, lot identity kept intact
body: We have capacity on the compact lines from October. Every cone stays attributable to one grower lot — we do not blend bales across origins, which costs us throughput and gains you a chain you can publish. Counts Ne 20 to 80.

title: Development runs from 80 metres — greige jersey and shirting
body: Most mills in the valley specialised. We kept both the air-jet weaving hall and the knitting floor, so a brand can take shirting and jersey from one greige source with matching yarn lots. Small development runs welcome.

title: Closed-loop piece dyeing, lab dips in five working days
body: Our effluent line has been closed-loop since 2019 and recovers 78% of process water. Recipe archives are kept per lot, so a repeat shade next season is the same shade. Custom colours from 200 metres.

title: Colour-sorted recycled cotton — no dye step needed
body: We sort by colour before tearing, so the fibre already carries its final shade. Blend it at 40% and the yarn reaches a heathered mid-grey without going near a dyehouse. Fourteen standing shades, from 500 kg.

title: 2026 Aegean harvest — bales carry a field-block code
body: The 2026 lint is ginned and graded. Each bale leaves with a field code that resolves back to a specific harvest block, and our spinners have been carrying it into cone labels for two seasons. Contracting now for multi-year volumes.

title: Structural timber traced to the forest parcel
body: Every delivery carries the parcel identifier, felling season and drying record — real data for a material passport, not a certificate scan. GL24h up to 18 metres, from Emmental and Entlebuch cooperatives only.

title: Structural precast at 62% recycled aggregate, declared per batch
body: The rubble comes from the Basel–Freiburg corridor and the source demolition sites are recorded on every delivery note. We publish the recycled content per batch, not as a product-line average — which is the number your tender actually needs.

title: Glazing you can open, reglaze and reseal on site
body: A failed insulating unit is normally landfill. Ours is built on a demountable spacer, so it is serviced instead of replaced — and about a third of our cullet comes back through our own take-back stream. U-value 0.6 W/m²K.

title: Insulation made from what farming already burns
body: Flax tow is a by-product — it is normally burned in the field. We open it, form it and thermally bond it without formaldehyde. 0.038 W/mK, compostable at end of life, cut to size from 50 m².
